verdicts.reason: A keeps the headline on one line and the CTA is strong. But the GLACIER logo sits under the headline, which reverses the brand-then-headline order. The can is a tiny fragment jammed against the left edge, and the legal line runs the full width, crammed against the bottom edge and up under the button. B has a more logical order (logo, then can, then headline, then CTA), but the headline breaks into 'Garden-fresh / fizz' with an orphaned word. Its can is a tiny afterthought under the logo, and the legal text is squeezed into a 4-line block of illegible micro type under the button. Both are cramped and none of the original's decorative circles survive.
